pairs.subject: search
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/SpellbookSearch.tsx:35 The Ctrl+K spellbook palette ranks nothing. It keeps every entry where all terms are substrings, in the order the index was built, and cuts at 20 with no marker that more exist, so blind-enter lands on the first-indexed item instead of the best match.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/SpellbookSearch.tsx:13 The palette debounces a synchronous in-memory scan (the standard says one that debounces has already failed its intent). It also has no weighted fuzzy or boundary scoring, no score floor, no recency/frequency prior, and an empty query shows the first 20 index rows rather than a personal list.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/SpellbookSearch.tsx:32 The matching policy is written inline at the call site: lowercase only, no diacritic folding, no minimum token length or term cap. A repo grep found no shared named matcher (no fuzzyScore/fuzzyMatch/NFD fold in src/lib, hooks or components).

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/SpellbookSearchPalette.tsx:151 Each result renders its plain label with no match marks, and a hit on a category name (e.g. typing 'effect') has no marked reason. Order is deterministic only because it is the index's insertion order; no relevance signal is involved.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/spellbook-search-index.ts:135 A scan is the right choice for this small, in-memory corpus. The derived list (with labelLower precomputed) is rebuilt from source by a pure builder, memoised on exactly the source arrays it indexes, so its recomputation is named and deterministic.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/SpellbookSearch.tsx:51 This is a navigate palette whose query is deliberately reset on every open. There is no filter or sort bundle worth naming and persisting.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/spellbook-search-index.ts:12 Category is shown as a badge and matched as text, but no facet panel or selectable filter dimension is offered, so the filter intent does not exist on this surface.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/SpellbookSearch.tsx:33 Input is only split into whitespace terms. There are no user-authored operators, identifiers or saved rules to type-check.
